page.overview:
Who is The Kombatant?

The Kombatant is a hideous four-armed Shokan fighter and a powerful monster created by Zaggot. It had all the best fighting skills and special abilities of the Earthrealm warriors. The Kombatant was killed by Goro with the help from a weapon given to him by Zaggot's brother, Abacus.
